channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Audio, Sound & Music, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 03 Aug 2026 (03 Aug to 09 Aug 2026).

  • Columbia Institute for Ideas and Imagination: Paris Fellowship 2027-28
    Columbia University Institute for Ideas and Imagination · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 75,000 stipend, plus housing at Reid Hall in Paris and office and research support, September 2027 to May 2028. No application fee.
